item.title: VinFast projects P413K savings with MPV 7
item.description: VinFast says owners of its MPV 7 electric seven-seater could save nearly P413,000 over three years compared with those who drive a conventional gasoline-powered vehicle, based on estimates from the automaker’s online ownership cost calculator.
